task.prompt:
CONTEXT:
Work in {project_root} on {date}. V719 wrote nine producer primaries and three conductor pre-gate receipts; two producer slots have neither. Static heads and reserved predictions qualified (Exp8334/8335). Local qualification failed three Exp8206 consumer assertions; runtime failed two Exp8307 authority assertions; ARC failed strict typing; cost consumers failed three Exp8329 assertions. GateMate history drifted. The capstone passed its memory checks but failed two branch replays. H1/H2 remain unmeasured. Preserve the frozen V717 science and historical outcomes. Cached observations are exposed development, not current model inference.
EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v719-preserved-20261009.md; openspec/change-proposals/v717-local-learning-protocol.json; results/experiment_8334_v719_sentence_spline_fit.json; python/carnot/verify/sentence_spline_fit_8334.py; python/carnot/verify/local_update_isolation_8306.py; results/experiment_8343_v719_kv260_workload_cost.json; results/experiment_8042_v696_precision_fallback_boundary.json
TASK:
Test lookup-table fidelity and refresh cost for frozen sentence splines. Deliver results/experiment_8352_v720_spline_table_fidelity.json. Create the thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8352_v720_spline_table_fidelity.py. Store primitive evidence under results/raw/experiment_8352_v720_spline_table_fidelity/. Future deliverables are dependencies, not existing inputs.
CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Emit a flushed start line. Authenticate source bytes, terminal sidecars and task authority. Check private scratch, tools and resources before work. Name missing external operands in gate_check_summary. Do not replace natural evidence with fixtures.
2. Emit a flushed progress line at every phase boundary. Emit one before and after every model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess. Print completed/pending counts inside long loops. Poll owned children at least every 60 seconds. Use unbuffered output and bounded deadlines. Keep every silence gap below 600 seconds. Write files over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most about 150 lines. Send a progress message between calls. No single huge tool call. Do not pad elapsed time.
3. Spec first: add relevant REQ-* and SCENARIO-* before implementation. Write focused failing tests first. Reuse existing modules through small adapters. Preserve assertions, guard thresholds and old evidence. Keep scratch in /tmp and runners in scripts/experiments/. Do not modify research-roadmap.yaml. Freeze validation commands before measurement.
4. Declare no_model_load, MODEL_SPECS=[] and zero current model calls. Identify cached verifier work or artifact aggregation as the inference_substrate. Training small numeric heads is not an LLM load.
5. Authenticate the exact Exp8334 checkpoint and V717 numeric spec directly. Do not depend on H1/H2 or the capstone. Read KANELE 2512.12850v3 and online KAN 2602.02056v4 full methods. Freeze this separate numerical adaptation in docs/research-notes/v720-table-protocol.md before running it.
6. Compare direct float64 spline evaluation with per-feature lookup tables on65,257,1025 evenly spaced grid points over[0,1]. Evaluate nearest and linear interpolation. Store table values as float64 or signed16-bit fixed point with11 fractional bits (step2^-11, range[-16,16-2^-11]); round ties to even and count saturation. Keep holistic slope, intercept, temperature and sigmoid float64 to isolate local-table error. This is not full integer inference.
7. Freeze a constructed panel of4096 four-feature vectors from RNG seed7208352. Add every knot and knot+/-1e-8 clipped to[0,1]. Add label-free action-boundary controls by solving x[0] for p=.25 and .75 plus/minus1e-6 under the frozen coefficients; if slope=0, report an unavailable boundary construction. Use no human labels and no reserved features. Compare to an independent SciPy spline reference.
8. Record probability error, each action flip, saturation, bytes and direct/table timing per vector and configuration. Require float64 direct parity<=1e-10. For a deployment candidate require maximum probability error<=.001 and zero flips on points whose reference probability is at least.002 from either action threshold. Report all near-threshold flips separately. Select the smallest table that passes, ties by lower error then fixed configuration order; no scientific utility claim.
9. Apply64 constructed local updates using the frozen step rule and seed7208352, alternating targets0/1. Compare full table rebuild with dependency-scoped refresh after each update. Enumerate grid entries whose basis support intersects changed coefficients. Require identical refreshed table bytes and no stale lookup values after restart. A deliberate missed-entry update must fail. Time evaluation, local update, refresh and serialization separately over one warmup and five paired repetitions. The64 updates test engineering only, not H2.
10. Write docs/research-notes/v720-table-fidelity.md and retain all configuration rows. Set table_fidelity_ready_score on qualified measurements regardless of whether any configuration qualifies; table_candidate_score marks an actual passing candidate. Numerical construction success is circular_positive, never natural accuracy. Produce a board operation manifest without creating or flashing RTL.
11. Run relevant unit and consumer tests, scoped Ruff check/format, strict mypy and scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>. Require 100 percent newly owned statements, including real CLI, child and failure paths. Use pytest -n 0 -o addopts= with private scratch. Record argv, exit, timing and log hashes. Do not run the full repository suite inside this experiment.
12. Cold-replay primitive evidence in a fresh process. Run valid, negative and self-consistently rehashed tamper controls. Use unchanged primary_publication checks, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate>. Keep all findings. An exit1 requires the existing typed finding consumer: only independently recomputed informational findings with deliberate-error controls can resolve. Errors, unknown severity, warnings and critical findings block readiness. Do not edit those validators or exemption lists. Publish the terminal primary atomically after checks. Owned failures are disqualified; unchanged external blocks are blocked, never partial. Reconcile openspec/, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md. Do not update generator weights or publish externally.
REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date: principle: Bind the invocation to its exact authority.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: honest_verdict starts complete_. Class is positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Partial means retryable unfinished owned work only.
gate_check_summary: principle: A block names upstream, path/hash, field, operator, expected and observed values. Missing is distinct from zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts, historical_model_provenance: principle: Separate current work from imported inference.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count, sample_size_budget: principle: Retain every intended unit and condition. Repeated timings do not add independent sources.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score, generalized_learning_benefit_score: principle: Oracle controls use circular_positive. Both generalization scores remain zero on exposed development.
required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, acceptance_gates, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path, adversarial_findings: principle: Readiness requires byte-bound checks, not scientific success.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum, source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes: principle: Bind claims to measured work and replayable inputs.
cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: List imported evidence and explain every added field.
table_fidelity_ready_score, table_candidate_score, configurations, per_vector_rows, refresh_rows: principle: Separate valid measurement from a deployable numeric candidate.
probability_error_max, action_flip_count, boundary_flip_count, saturation_count, table_bytes, operation_manifest: principle: Full error and storage costs constrain a future hardware implementation.
Run command: cd {project_root} && PYTHONPATH=python:. PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_8352_v720_spline_table_fidelity.py --date {date}
Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
